_doc: R1's water network: GENERATED by tools/environment/water/build_water_json.py from data/world/maps/r1/layout.json. Do not hand-edit; change the layout (the lead) or the builder and rerun.
Units m and m/s; north is -Z. Channel nodes are node_fields rows every ~8 m along the centre line; values between two rows are linear in s. offset is signed, + on the right bank looking downstream.

Reaches scale flow by world state, eased back to 1 over ease_m past their ends. Steps and pounds are live from their milestone on. Pound curves are by bible days since the river stopped (S1's first day).
First numbers (bed depths, speeds, the drop curve) are proposals for T4 and the lead to confirm.
